_comment: Single source of truth per call type: questions (live prompt + record_answer keys), call_type_block (prompt), extraction_fields (Gemini post-call JSON, English values), sheet_columns (Google Sheet tab order). Columns not in extraction_fields are filled from the calls/customers rows: call_id, phone, call_duration, language.

owner_summary_fields.headline: string, one line the owner reads first, e.g. 'Happy with food, wants review link; complained about late setup'
owner_summary_fields.key_points: array of 2-5 short English strings: only what the owner needs to know
owner_summary_fields.action_items: array of {what: string, who: 'team' | 'owner', by_when: string | null}
owner_summary_fields.money_mentioned: string | null, quote amounts or payment questions exactly as given by tools
owner_summary_fields.urgency: low | normal | high (high = complaint, event within 7 days, or customer asked for owner)

post_event_feedback.label: Post-event feedback
post_event_feedback.call_type_block: This is an outbound follow-up 1-3 days after the customer's event. Goal: get honest feedback on food, quantity, service and timing, whether they would book again and recommend us. If they are happy, ask if our team may send a Google review link. If they complain: apologise, note details, schedule a callback with the owner. Never offer refunds or discounts.

questions.text: Confirm the person and the event (type, day, area).
Was the quantity enough for all guests?
How were our staff and service? (rating 1-5)
Any dish guests especially liked, or anything we should improve?
Would you recommend us? If happy, may our team send a Google review link?

enquiry_followup.label: Enquiry follow-up
enquiry_followup.when: 2-3 days after a quote request that did not book
enquiry_followup.call_type_block: This is an outbound follow-up on a quote the customer asked for. Goal: answer their doubts, recalculate the quote with calculate_quote if guests or package changed, offer a tasting (free for 300+ guests, otherwise Rs 1,500 adjusted in the bill) or a tentative booking. If not interested, politely ask why.

questions.text: Remind them of their enquiry (event type, date, guests).
Do you have any questions about the menu or the quote?
If guests or package changed, give an updated quote (tool).
Offer a tasting or a tentative booking.
If not interested, politely ask why (price, date, another caterer, event cancelled).

pre_event_confirmation.label: Pre-event confirmation
pre_event_confirmation.call_type_block: This is an outbound call 5-6 days before the event. Goal: confirm date, serving time, venue address with landmark, final guest count (this is the minimum billed), menu changes (allowed until 7 days before; later changes go to the team as a callback), venue access 4 hours before serving, water and power, and remind that the balance is due 3 days before (the team will share payment details; no payment on this call).

questions.text: Confirm the event date and serving time.
Confirm the venue address with a landmark.
Confirm the final guest count (minimum billed).
Venue access 4 hours before serving, water and power available?
Remind: balance due 3 days before; team will share payment details.

inbound.label: Inbound call
inbound.call_type_block: The customer called us. Find out what they need (question, quote, availability, booking, complaint) and help. Ask for their name and phone number only when you need them for a booking or callback, and read the phone number back digit by digit. End by repeating the next step.

extraction_fields.intent: question | quote | availability | booking | complaint | other
